```{r}
 #You are currently using the Single Nucleotide Variant (SNV) filter code specifically for Whole Genome Analysis in hg38.
#If you want to specifically look for panel genes in your file, please go to PGA_SNV_hg38.
#"You are currently using the Single Nucleotide Variant (SNV) filter code specifically for Whole Genome Analysis for TCAG pipeline 28.5",
#  "If you want to specifically look for panel genes in your file, please go to PGA_SNV_hg38.",
#  "If you are starting from the original TCAG file, import it with the command below."
#Please name your file 'patientdata' so the script can recognise it.


  messages <- c(
    "You are currently using the Single Nucleotide Variant (SNV) filter code specifically for Whole Genome Analysis.",
    "If you want to specifically look for panel genes in your file, please go to PGA_SNV_hg38",
    "If you are starting from the original TCAG file, import it with the command below."
  )
  
  # Loop through and print each with a pause
  for (msg in messages) {
    cat(msg, "\n")
    Sys.sleep(2)  # Adjust seconds to your preference
  }
  
  # Helper function for CRAN packages
  install_and_load <- function(pkg) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } else {
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  
  install_and_load_bioc <- function(pkg) {
    if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
      if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages("BiocManager")
        library(BiocManager)
      }
      BiocManager::install(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } else {
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }   
  
  
  
  # CRAN packages
  cran_packages <- c(
    "data.table",
    "conflicted",
    "tidyverse",
    "writexl",
    "dplyr",
    "readr",
    "readxl",
    "openxlsx"
  )
  
  # Bioconductor packages
  bioc_packages <- c(
    "AnnotationDbi",
    "org.Hs.eg.db"
  )
  
  # Install and load CRAN packages
  lapply(cran_packages, install_and_load)
  
  # Install and load Bioconductor packages
  lapply(bioc_packages, install_and_load_bioc)
  
 
  
   ##### Block to import file#########################################
  #Main
  print('Input patient file')
  fileName = file.choose()
  if(!tolower(data.table::last(unlist(strsplit(fileName,'\\.'))))%in%c('tsv','csv','txt','dsv')){
    stop("Unsupported file format",call. = F)
  }
  outName = sub("\\..*$", "", basename(fileName))
  time_elapsed = proc.time()
  repTimes = length(strsplit(readLines(fileName, n=1),','))
  currentdata = fread(fileName,colClasses = rep('character',repTimes),na.strings="NA",data.table=F)
  names(currentdata) = sapply(strsplit(names(currentdata),'\\:'),function(i){i[[length(i)]]}) 
  numLines = nrow(currentdata)
  print(paste('Initial row count:',nrow(currentdata)))
  
  if ("spliceAI_DS_AL" %in% colnames(currentdata)){
    currentdata$sAI_delta = as.numeric(currentdata$'spliceAI_DS_AG')+ as.numeric(currentdata$'spliceAI_DS_AL')+ as.numeric(currentdata$'spliceAI_DS_DG')+as.numeric(currentdata$'spliceAI_DS_DL')
    currentdata$sAI_delta <- currentdata$sAI_delta %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  }
  
  if ("promoterAI_score"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {
    currentdata$promoterAInum = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(currentdata$promoterAI_score))
    currentdata$promoterAInum <- currentdata$promoterAInum %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  }
  
 FilterStep <- list(
    Step = character(0),  # Empty character vector for Step names
    Count = numeric(0)    # Empty numeric vector for Count values
  )
  
  #For maths later on
  count_removed_and_remaining_rows <- function(modified_data) {
    removed_rows <- numLines - nrow(modified_data)
    remaining_rows <- nrow(modified_data)
    #Apparently dplyr and datatable have last as a function so i just changed it to lastlast (now everybody go chop breakfast)
    lastlast <- function(x){x[[length(x)]]}
    
    cat(paste("This action removed", removed_rows, "rows.\n"))
    cat(paste("There are currently", remaining_rows, "rows remaining.\n"))
  }
  
  allDups = function(value){duplicated(value) | duplicated(value, fromLast = TRUE)} 
    
  
  InitialRow <- nrow(currentdata)
  InitialText <- "Initial Number of Variants"
  FilterStep$Step <- c(InitialText)
  FilterStep$Count <- c(InitialRow)
  #rm(patientdata, envir = .GlobalEnv )
  
  
  names(currentdata) <- make.names(names(currentdata), unique = TRUE)

  

    
    cat("Quality filtering will now commence!\n")
    #Filter FILTER = PASS; all variants that pass the filter check
    cat("Filtering for variants that PASS the filter check.\n")
    currentdata <- currentdata[currentdata$FILTER%in%'PASS',]
    count_removed_and_remaining_rows(currentdata)
      
    currentdata$newDP <- as.numeric(currentdata$AD_ALT)+as.numeric(currentdata$AD_REF)
    currentdata <- currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata$newDP)>=7,]
    currentdata <- currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata$newDP)<=120,]
    Quality_Row <- nrow(currentdata)
    Quality_Text <- "Quality Filter: FILTER = PASS & 7 > Depth > 120"
    count_removed_and_remaining_rows(currentdata)
    
    FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, Quality_Text)
    FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, Quality_Row)
    #wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
    #sheet_name <<- as.character("Quality_Filtered_Variants")
    # addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    # final_file <- paste0(Dnumber, "_qualityfilter.xlsx")
    # writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = currentdata)
    # Save the Excel file
    # saveWorkbook(wb, file = final_file)
    
 
  
  
  ## 0.5% Filtering of Population #
  

    cat("Population filtering will now commence!\n")
  
    #Filter A1000g_freq_max
    if ("A1000g_freq_max"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {
      currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'A1000g_freq_max'])<=0.005,]}
   
    
    #Filter gnomadV4_exome_fafmax_faf95_max
    if ("gnomadV4_exome_fafmax_faf95_max"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_exome_fafmax_faf95_max'])<=0.005,]} 
   
    #Filter gnomadV4_gnomadV4_exome_AF_grpmax
    if ("gnomadV4_exome_AF_grpmax"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_exome_AF_grpmax'])<=0.005,]}
   
    
    
    #gnomadV4_genome_fafmax_faf95_max
    if ("gnomadV4_genome_fafmax_faf95_max"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_genome_fafmax_faf95_max'])<=0.005,]}
    
    
    #gnomadV4_genome_AF_grpmax
    if ("gnomadV4_genome_AF_grpmax"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_genome_AF_grpmax'])<=0.005,]}
   
    
    #hsint_AF_all
    if ("hsint_AF_all"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'hsint_AF_all'])<=0.01,]} 
   
    
    #hsint_AF_EUR
    if ("hsint_AF_EUR"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'hsint_AF_EUR'])<=0.01,]}
    
    
    #gnomadV4_exome_AF_remaining
    if ("gnomadV4_exome_AF_remaining"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_exome_AF_remaining'])<=0.005,]}
    
    
    #gnomadV4_genome_AF_remaining
    if ("gnomadV4_genome_AF_remaining"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_genome_AF_remaining'])<=0.005,]}
    
    
    #filter out variants with >7 homozygous counts in gnomAD exome or genome
    if ("gnomadV4_genome_nhomalt"%in%colnames (currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[(as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_genome_nhomalt']))  <= 7,]}
    
    
    if ("gnomadV4_exome_nhomalt"%in%colnames (currentdata)) {currentdata = currentdata[(as.numeric(currentdata[,'gnomadV4_exome_nhomalt']))  <= 7,]}
     
    
    count_removed_and_remaining_rows(currentdata)
    RareRow <- nrow(currentdata)
    RareText <- " Frequency Filtering (1000 Genomes & gnomAD <= 0.05%)"
    FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, RareText)
    FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, RareRow)
    
    #######delete next hash tags if you need a pop freq table
    #     wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
    #  sheet_name <<- as.character("popfreq_r_05_100")
    #  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
    #  final_file <- paste0(Dnumber, "_popfreq_05_100.xlsx")
    # writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = currentdata)
    
    # if (file.exists(final_file)) {
    #   counter <<- 1
    #   dup_file <<- paste0(Dnumber, "_", counter, "_popfreq_05_100.xlsx")
    
    #    while (file.exists(dup_file)) {
    #       counter <<- counter + 1
    #       dup_file <<- paste0(Dnumber,"_", counter, "_popfreq_05_100.xlsx")
    #    }
    #   saveWorkbook(wb, file = dup_file)
    #    cat(paste0("File saved as '", dup_file, "'.\n"))
    #} else {
    #  saveWorkbook(wb, file = final_file)
    #   paste0(final_file, "saved successfully!\n")
    
  

  cat("Variant type filtering will now commence!\n")
  
  # keep promoterAI data
  #currentdata$promoterAInum = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(currentdata$promoterAI_score))
  if ("promoterAI_score"%in% colnames(currentdata)) {promoterAI <- currentdata[!is.na(currentdata$promoterAInum) & (currentdata$promoterAInum > 0.1 | currentdata$promoterAInum < -0.1),]
  print(paste(nrow(promoterAI),'variants of with positive or negative promoterAI values were saved.')) }
  
  #Keep FANTOM5 categorical data as 1 and 2
  if ("Fantom5DPI"%in% colnames(currentdata))  {FANTOM5 = currentdata [ currentdata$Fantom5DPI%in%"2",]
  print(paste(nrow(FANTOM5),'variants overlapping stringent FANTOM5 motifs were saved.'))}
  
  
  RemoveforGenic <-  c('downstream','intergenic','ncRNA_exonic','ncRNA_intronic','ncRNA_splicing','ncRNA_UTR3','ncRNA_UTR5','upstream','upstream;downstream','UTR3','UTR5','UTR5;UTR3','ncRNA_exonic;ncRNA_splicing')
  
  currentdata <-currentdata[!currentdata$typeseq_priority%in%RemoveforGenic,]
  GenicRow <- nrow(currentdata)
  GenicText <- "Genic Variants"
  FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, GenicText)
  FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, GenicRow)
  
  #  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  # sheet_name <<- as.character("Genic_Variants")
  # addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  # final_file <- paste0(Dnumber, "_genic_variants.xlsx")
  # writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x =  genic_variants)
  # Save the Excel file
  # saveWorkbook(wb, file = final_file)
  




#then coerce the required columns into a numeric format
cat("Splice AI filtering - cutoff is 0.1.\n")
#Filering for variants that have a Splice AI scoreabove cutoff#
spliceAI_data = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'sAI_delta'])>= 0.1,]
print(paste(nrow(spliceAI_data),'variants with sum  of delta score in SpliceAI2 over 0.1 were saved.'))

#######collect dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE over 0.6
currentdata$dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE <- currentdata$dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
currentdata$dbscSNV_RF_SCORE <- currentdata$dbscSNV_RF_SCORE %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
dbscSNV1 = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE'])>=0.6,]
dbscSNV2 = currentdata[as.numeric(currentdata[,'dbscSNV_RF_SCORE'])>=0.6,]
dbscSNV = rbind(dbscSNV1, dbscSNV2)
dbscSNV=dbscSNV[!duplicated(dbscSNV), ]

Splice = rbind(spliceAI_data, dbscSNV)
Splice= Splice[!duplicated(Splice), ]


Splice_Text <- "Splice AI and dbscSNV splice Filtering"
Splice_Row <- nrow(Splice)
FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, Splice_Text)
FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, Splice_Row)




#############################


  cat("Loss-of-Function only filtering will now commence!\n")
 # dup_cols <- which(duplicated(names(currentdata)))
  # if (length(dup_cols) > 0) {
  #  names(currentdata)[dup_cols] <<- paste(names(currentdata)[dup_cols], seq_along(dup_cols), sep = "_")}
  #keep loss of function 
  LOFkeep <- c('frameshift deletion', 'frameshift insertion', 'stoploss','stopgain','startloss')
  #nonframeshift indels
  keep2 = c('nonframeshift insertion','nonframeshift deletion')
  LOF2 = currentdata[currentdata$effect_priority%in%keep2,]
  LOF2$dbsnp_region <- LOF2$dbsnp_region %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  LOF2 = LOF2[str_count(as.character(LOF2$dbsnp_region), ',')<=4,]
  LOF2$dbsnp_region[LOF2$dbsnp_region == 0] <- NA
  
  #keep ClinVar terms
  ClinVarkeep <- c('Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic', 'Likely_pathogenic', 'Pathogenic')
  ClinVar_data <- currentdata[currentdata$Clinvar_SIG%in%ClinVarkeep,]
  
  LOFonly_data <- currentdata[currentdata$effect_priority%in%LOFkeep,]
  effect_data <- rbind(ClinVar_data,LOFonly_data,LOF2 )
  effect_data <- effect_data[!duplicated(effect_data), ]
  LOF_Row <- nrow(effect_data)
  LOF_Text <- "Effect Filtering Variant Effect + ClinVar Significance"
  FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, LOF_Text)
  FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, LOF_Row)


#Predicitve Pathogenic Filtering#

  #allDups <- function(value){duplicated(value) | duplicated(value, fromLast = TRUE)} 
  cat("Filtering via pathogenic filters will now commence with pre-set cut offs!\n")
  user_cutoffs <- list(
    # sift_scorecutoff = 0.05,
   # polyphen_scorecutoff = 0.8,
    #ma_scorecutoff = 2,
    spx_dpsicutoff = 2,
    phylopPMam_avgcutoff = 1.5,
    phylopVert100_avgcutoff = 4,
    PROVEAN_scorecutoff = -2.5,
    CADD_phredcutoff = 15,
    alpha_missense_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    primateai3d_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    MPC_scorecutoff = 2,
    REVEL_cutoff = 0.5
  )
  invisible(assign("user_cutoffs", user_cutoffs, envir = .GlobalEnv))
  
  
  #dup_cols <- which(duplicated(names(currentdata)))
  #if (length(dup_cols) > 0) {
  #  names(currentdata)[dup_cols] <- paste(names(currentdata)[dup_cols], seq_along(dup_cols), sep = "_")}
  predVote = suppressWarnings(cbind(
    #as.numeric(currentdata$sift_score) <=  user_cutoffs$sift_scorecutoff, 
   # as.numeric(currentdata$polyphen_score) >= user_cutoffs$polyphen_scorecutoff, 
    #as.numeric(currentdata$ma_score) >= user_cutoffs$ma_scorecutoff,
    abs(as.numeric(currentdata$spx_dpsi)) <= user_cutoffs$spx_dpsicutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$phylopMam_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopPMam_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$phylopVert100_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopVert100_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$PROVEAN_score) <= user_cutoffs$PROVEAN_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$CADD_phred) >= user_cutoffs$CADD_phredcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$MPC_score) >= user_cutoffs$MPC_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$primateai3d_score) >= user_cutoffs$primateai3d_scorecuttoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$alpha_missense_score) >= user_cutoffs$alpha_missense_scorecuttoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$REVEL_score) >= user_cutoffs$REVEL_cutoff))
  
  ind = rowSums(predVote, na.rm=TRUE)
  pathogenicfilter_data = currentdata[ind>=2,]
  
  
  #pathogenicfilter_data <- dplyr::filter(currentdata, ind >= 2)
  #pathogenicfilter_data <- pathogenicfilter_data %>%
  #  dplyr::filter(!(effect_priority %in% c('nonframeshift insertion', 'nonframeshift deletion') & str_count(dbsnp_region, ",") >= #4)) 
  if ("Clinvar_SIG" %in% colnames(currentdata) && "Clinvar_ReviewStatus" %in% colnames(currentdata) ) {
    names(pathogenicfilter_data) <- make.names(names(pathogenicfilter_data), unique = TRUE)
    pathogenicfilter_data <- pathogenicfilter_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(!(Clinvar_SIG %in%c('Benign') & Clinvar_ReviewStatus %in% c('no_assertion_criteria_provided')))
  }
  pathogenicfilter_data$ind <- NULL
  pred.path_Row <- nrow(pathogenicfilter_data)
  pred.path_Text <- "Passed Predictor Filtering"
  FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, pred.path_Text)
  FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, pred.path_Row)
  
  with_PAI_F5 <- c("promoterAI_score", "Fantom5DPI")
  
  if (all(with_PAI_F5 %in% colnames(currentdata))) {
    currentdata <- rbind(effect_data, pathogenicfilter_data, FANTOM5, Splice, promoterAI)
  } else {
    currentdata <- rbind(effect_data, pathogenicfilter_data, Splice)
  }
 
   Strong_Var_Row <- nrow(currentdata)
  Strong_Var_Text <- "Predicted as damaging, deleterious, conserved or splicing"
  FilterStep$Step <- c(FilterStep$Step, Strong_Var_Text)
  FilterStep$Count <- c(FilterStep$Count, Strong_Var_Row)
  currentdata <- currentdata[!duplicated(currentdata), ]
  currentdata <- currentdata[order(currentdata$gene_symbol),] 



  currentdata$VariantScore <- 0
  # Remove the row if it is exactly "Benign"
  # Sets up cutoffs that earn 1 mark
  user_cutoffs <- list(
    # sift_scorecutoff = 0.05,
   # polyphen_scorecutoff = 0.8,
    #ma_scorecutoff = 2,
    spx_dpsicutoff = 2,
    phylopPMam_avgcutoff = 1.5,
    phylopVert100_avgcutoff = 4,
    PROVEAN_scorecutoff = -2.5,
    CADD_phredcutoff = 15,
    alpha_missense_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    primateai3d_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    MPC_scorecutoff = 2,
    REVEL_cutoff = 0.5
  )

  
  # Calculate full cutoff scores
  predVote = suppressWarnings(cbind(
    #as.numeric(currentdata$sift_score) <= user_cutoffs$sift_scorecutoff, 
    #as.numeric(currentdata$polyphen_score) >= user_cutoffs$polyphen_scorecutoff, 
    #as.numeric(currentdata$ma_score) >= user_cutoffs$ma_scorecutoff,
    abs(as.numeric(currentdata$spx_dpsi)) <= user_cutoffs$spx_dpsicutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$phylopMam_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopPMam_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$phylopVert100_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopVert100_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$PROVEAN_score) <= user_cutoffs$PROVEAN_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$CADD_phred) >= user_cutoffs$CADD_phredcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$alpha_missense) >= user_cutoffs$alpha_missensecutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$primateai3d) >= user_cutoffs$primateai3dcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$MPC_score) >= user_cutoffs$MPC_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$CADD_phred) >= user_cutoffs$CADD_phredcutoff,
    as.numeric(currentdata$REVEL_score) >= user_cutoffs$REVEL_cutoff
  ))
  
  # Assign full scores
  currentdata$ind <- rowSums(predVote, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  currentdata$VariantScore <- currentdata$ind  
  
  #Loop that looks at some other significant scores
  if ("Clinvar_SIG" %in% colnames(currentdata)) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(currentdata)) {
      if (grepl("pathogenic", currentdata$Clinvar_SIG[i], ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 30
      } else if (grepl("Conflicting", currentdata$Clinvar_SIG[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 2
      } else if (grepl("Uncertain", currentdata$Clinvar_SIG[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 2
      } 
    }
  }
  if ("effect_priority" %in% colnames(currentdata)) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(currentdata)) {
      if (grepl("frameshift", currentdata$effect_priority[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 15
      }
      if (grepl("stopgain", currentdata$effect_priority[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 15
      }
      if (grepl("startloss", currentdata$effect_priority[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 5
      }
      if (grepl("stoploss", currentdata$effect_priority[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 5
      }
      if (grepl("inframe", currentdata$effect_priority[i])) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 5
      }
    }
  }
  
  if ("sAI_delta" %in% colnames(currentdata)) {
    for (i in 1:nrow(currentdata)) {
      if (any(currentdata$sAI_delta >= 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 1
      } else if (any(currentdata$sAI_delta >= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 0.5
      }
    }
  }
  # 6. MPO column
  if (grepl("vision", currentdata$MPO[i])) {
    currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 1
  }
  
  # 7. HPO column
  if (grepl("eye", currentdata$HPO[i])) {
    currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 1
  }
  
  # 8.FANTOM5 
  if  ("Fantom5DPI" %in% colnames(currentdata) &&
         any(currentdata$Fantom5DPI == 2, na.rm = TRUE)) { 
    currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i] + 0.5
  }
  
  # 9.PromoterAI
  if ("promoterAI" %in% colnames(currentdata) &&
      any(abs(as.numeric(currentdata$promoterAInum)) > 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)) { 
    currentdata$VariantScore[i] <- currentdata$VariantScore[i]  + 0.5
      }
  
  currentdata <- currentdata[order(-currentdata$VariantScore), ]
 
  
  FilterRows <- data.frame(
    Step = FilterStep$Step,
    Count = FilterStep$Count,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )  
  
  
  wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  sheet_name_all <- as.character("strong_variants")
  sheet_name_snv <- as.character("SNV_Filter_History")
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name_all)
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name_snv)
  final_file <- paste0(outName, "_Strong_variants.xlsx")
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name_all, x = currentdata)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name_snv, x = FilterRows)
  # Save the Excel file
  if (file.exists(final_file)) {
    counter <- 1
    dup_file <- paste0(outName, "_", counter, "_Strong_variants.xlsx")
    
    while (file.exists(dup_file)) {
      counter <- counter + 1
      dup_file <- paste0(outName,"_", counter, "_Strong_variants.xlsx")
    }
    saveWorkbook(wb, file = dup_file)
    cat(paste0("File saved as '", dup_file, "'.\n"))
  } else {
    saveWorkbook(wb, file = final_file)
    paste0(final_file, "saved successfully!\n")
    
  }
  
  
  
```
